text: APPROVE. Both `try`/`catch` blocks move into `TryEnumerate`, which still materialises the enumeration inside the `try` and still skips on `IOException` or `UnauthorizedAccessException`, so behaviour is unchanged. By my count the method's complexity drops from 17 to 13 (the eight points from the four catches become four from the two null checks), the CHA0004 pragma is kept around the catches, and I see nothing that would break the warnings-as-errors build, though I haven't built it.
